title: Grito de Dolores
summary: In the early hours of 16 September 1810, the priest Miguel Hidalgo y Costilla rang the church bells in Dolores, now Dolores Hidalgo, and addressed his followers, an event that marks the start of the Mexican War of Independence. His plot had been discovered, so he moved the uprising forward. Independence came after about a decade of war.
